versions.changelog:
gmgn-base-tracker v0.1.0 — Initial release

- Launches comprehensive token tracking for Base chain via GMGN.AI.
- Supports four key sections: Trenches (Almost Bonded, Migrated), Trending (1h), Discover (Smart Money, KOL, LIVE, Fresh Wallet, Sniper), and Monitor (Track Smart & KOL 1h).
- Includes real-time data lookups, structured tables, and analyst commentary for actionable insights.
- Built-in formatting rules for prices, volumes, and percentage changes.
- Offers direct links to GMGN and DexScreener for each token.
- Provides clear trigger commands and detailed output for tokens and wallets.
